needed.suggestion: Remove the obstruction blocking the left footway to allow safe pedestrian use.
Add a pedestrian refuge island to the left side of the marked crossing to improve safety for pedestrians crossing a potentially wider road.
Install dropped kerbs at both ends of the left side marked crossing to assist wheelchair users and reduce crossing time.
Install additional street lighting along the entire left side of the road to enhance visibility and safety for pedestrians crossing at night or in low-light conditions.
